items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Willie was a great musician.

ctx.x: Well, what about somebody like Willie Smith?

Oh, he was in my classification. I class him down there with me. There wasn't but two...you know what I mean, two tops, and that was Johnny and Benny -- in my classification. Everybody else, they were down there with me. Yeah, Willie was a great musician. And there was a lot of others. But there was not one, but two at the top, and that was Johnny Hodges and Benny Carter. Johnny was playin' things, he didn't know what he was playin', and Benny was playin' everything, and he did know what he was playin'. Yup,…
